event.text: Call 911 now. Stay put, unlock your door, and do not drive yourself. Crushing central chest pressure lasting 30 minutes with left-arm radiation, sweating and nausea can mean a heart attack, which needs an ECG and blood tests right away. If you pass out or stop breathing, a bystander should tell the dispatcher immediately and follow their instructions.
